test_objective: Check that one can replace an existing entity and that scopes are replaced

test_cases.name: 054_03_01 Replace an existing entity having scopes
test_cases.doc: Check that one can replace an existing entity and that scopes are replaced
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entity_id}'
        method set to 'PUT'
        Replace Entity and
    Query Parameter: entity_id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: filename set to '${entity_replacement_filename}' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
